title: What's Your Cradle Path?
dek: Seven questions. Seven Paths. Find the sacred art that fits your soul.
intro: In Cradle, sacred artists cycle aura into their madra and follow a Path: a set of techniques built on particular aspects like fire, sword, light or dream. Which one would be yours?
spoiler_boundary: Books 1–3 (Unsouled, Soulsmith, Blackflame). Nothing from later books.
disclaimer: Unofficial fan quiz. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Will Wight or his publishers. Go read the books.

outcomes.name: Path of Black Flame
outcomes.tagline: Burn hotter than anything that stands in your way.
outcomes.description: Fire and destruction, woven together into one of the most feared Paths there is. You don't do subtle. You do relentless: every obstacle is fuel, every setback makes the fire hotter, and people who underestimate you tend to regret it very quickly.
outcomes.watch_out: Cozy stories where nothing is on fire.
outcomes.share_text: My Cradle Path is the Path of Black Flame. I burn hotter than anything in my way. What's yours?

outcomes.name: Path of the Endless Sword
outcomes.description: Sword madra, sharpened to a single purpose. You're blunt, direct and absolutely relentless, and you'd rather cut through a problem than talk around it. Your loyalty is just as sharp as your edge, even if you'd never say so out loud.
outcomes.share_text: My Cradle Path is the Path of the Endless Sword. Everything can be cut. What's yours?

outcomes.name: Path of the White Fox
outcomes.tagline: Reality is more of a suggestion.
outcomes.description: Dream madra and illusions, from a Path tied to a sacred white fox. You win with misdirection, patience and the look on someone's face when they realize the thing they were fighting was never there.
outcomes.share_text: My Cradle Path is the Path of the White Fox. Reality is more of a suggestion. What's yours?

outcomes.name: Path of Heaven's Glory
outcomes.description: Burning light madra, taught at a school on the mountain. You like structure: clear ranks, real teachers and a proper way of doing things. You climb by discipline, and your techniques shine bright enough to hurt.
outcomes.share_text: My Cradle Path is the Path of Heaven's Glory. Light, as a weapon. What's yours?

outcomes.name: Path of the Stellar Spear
outcomes.tagline: Strike first. Strike true. Remember everything.
outcomes.description: The signature spear art of a proud clan. You're precise, ambitious and you never, ever forget a slight. Your rivals should know that every defeat you suffer is just the first chapter of your comeback.
outcomes.share_text: My Cradle Path is the Path of the Stellar Spear. Strike first, strike true, remember everything. What's yours?

outcomes.name: Path of the Fisherman
outcomes.tagline: Why fight it when you can build something better?
outcomes.description: Force madra with a gentle pull, perfect for soulsmithing. You're the crafter: the one who turns scraps into constructs and makes everyone else's gear actually work. You're cranky about it, sure. You're also indispensable.
outcomes.watch_out: Stories that are all fighting and no making.
outcomes.share_text: My Cradle Path is the Path of the Fisherman. Why fight it when you can build something better? What's yours?

outcomes.name: Pure Madra (Heart of Twin Stars)
outcomes.tagline: They called you Unsouled. They were wrong.
outcomes.description: You started with a core too weak to earn a Path, so you made your own advantages: a split core, a technique that disrupts an enemy's madra, and a plan for every situation. Nobody out-prepares you, and nobody works harder.
outcomes.share_text: My Cradle Path is Pure Madra. They called me Unsouled. They were wrong. What's yours?

questions.prompt: You sit down to cycle. What aura do you want to draw in?

options.label: Fire and destruction. Power that burns everything down.
Sword aura. Everything can be cut.
Dream aura. Reality is more of a suggestion.
Light and sword aura, sharpened into a spear point.

questions.prompt: Which kind of technique do you master first?

options.label: A Striker technique that sends my blade's edge across the room.
A Ruler technique that fills the room with illusions.
A Striker technique made of burning light.
Soulsmithing. I'd rather build constructs than throw techniques.

questions.prompt: Which clan or school do you want to join?

options.label: The clan that follows the Path of a sacred white fox.
The school on the mountain, where light is a weapon.
The Jai clan: proud spear artists with long memories.
None of them. I'll find my own way, even if they call me Unsouled.

questions.prompt: You face someone a full stage above you. Your plan?

options.label: Overwhelm them with radiant attacks from range.
Strike first, strike precisely, and never forget the insult.
Out-build them. My constructs do the heavy lifting.
Burn hotter than they can take.

questions.prompt: What kind of teacher do you want?

options.label: A clan elder who demands perfection.
A cranky old soulsmith who's secretly proud of me.
Anyone who'll teach me. I'll take every scrap I can get.
A legendary swordmaster who pushes me past every limit.

questions.prompt: You find a treasure in an ancient ruin. Which one do you take?

options.label: Rare materials to build something incredible.
A cycling manual everyone else ignored.
A dangerous power everyone warns me not to take.
A charm that lets me walk through dreams.
Outthink everyone. Every advantage counts when you start with nothing.
Relentlessly. I'll burn through every stage.
Directly. Find the problem and cut through it.
By the rules. Train, test, climb the ranks.
